subject: Partner solution workshop: Redwood + OptiCloud - scheduling / architecture deep-dive
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@opticloud.com>, Vikram Patel <vikram.patel@azure.microsoft.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Partner solution workshop: Redwood + OptiCloud - scheduling / architecture deep-dive

Hi Samir / Vikram —

Thanks for the productive call last week. Per our discussion, we'd like to schedule a joint solution workshop (Redwood + OptiCloud + Azure Marketplace) to do a technical deep-dive on the integration path and a short architecture review. Goal: align on deployment topology, marketplace listing requirements, and next steps for a joint listing.

Proposed scope (90 min):
- 20 min: introductions + success criteria
- 40 min: architecture walkthrough (Redwood runtime, KV cache, tenant isolation options)
- 20 min: marketplace & listing checklist (Azure Marketplace fields and commercial flow)
- 10 min: actions & next steps / owners

Proposed slots next week (please indicate all that work for your teams):
- Mon, Mar 1: 10:00-11:30 PST
- Mon, Mar 1: 15:00-16:30 PST
- Wed, Mar 3: 09:30-11:00 PST

Attendees from our side: Neha Kapoor (SE, architecture), Vivek Kulkarni (partner lead), myself. Please share who from OptiCloud and Azure should join (engineers and marketplace contact recommended).

I've attached a draft agenda for your review. If Azure needs a short pre-call to cover the listing checklist, happy to include that too.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on the calendar.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Biz Dev Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Attachment: draft-agenda-redwood-opticloud.pdf

From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@opticloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner solution workshop: Redwood + OptiCloud - scheduling / architecture deep-dive

Hi Marissa —

Thanks — excited to move this forward. Quick note on availability: Mon Mar 1 mid-morning is tight for our lead engineer; we have good availability Mon Mar 1 early afternoon and Tue Mar 2. We can also do Wed Mar 3 morning if you prefer.

Requested attendees from our side: myself, Priya Reddy (product), and our lead engineer Arjun Rao. We would prefer a 60- to 75-minute working session focused on the architecture and marketplace requirements.

Also: can you share the current deployment diagram and any tenant-onboarding notes so our engineer can prep?

Cheers,
Samir Shah
Head of Partnerships, OptiCloud Solutions
samir.shah@opticloud.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@opticloud.com>, Vikram Patel <vikram.patel@azure.microsoft.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 13:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner solution workshop: Redwood + OptiCloud - scheduling / architecture deep-dive

Thanks Samir — noted. For internal alignment a slightly longer block helps (we want to cover both architecture and marketplace checklist end-to-end), but we can tighten to 75 minutes if that helps you.

Updated slots (please confirm availability):
- Mon, Mar 1: 10:00-11:15 PST (preferred by SEs)
- Mon, Mar 1: 15:00-16:15 PST (fallback)
- Wed, Mar 3: 09:30-10:45 PST

I've attached an updated agenda (shortened to 75 min) and included a request for your attendee list. Neha will lead the architecture walkthrough; Vivek will cover partnership milestones.

If Azure Marketplace wants to run a separate 20-min pre-call for listing specifics, we can schedule that the week prior.

Regards,
Marissa

Attachment: updated-agenda-redwood-opticloud.pdf

From: Vikram Patel <vikram.patel@azure.microsoft.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Samir Shah <samir.shah@opticloud.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner solution workshop: Redwood + OptiCloud - scheduling / architecture deep-dive

Hi all —

I can join for a 60-minute window on Mon Mar 1; 10:30-11:30 PST would work best. If you end up needing 75 minutes that's fine but we'd prefer a hard stop at 11:30.

To help our marketplace engineers prepare, could you please drop in: (1) an architecture diagram that shows tenant/network boundaries and any public endpoints, (2) a short list of required telemetry/logging controls (audit logs, retention), and (3) any onboarding steps for the marketplace offering.

Also linking the Azure checklist that teams typically use: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/marketplace/marketplace-checklist — it may be helpful to reference that during the call.

Thanks,
Vikram Patel
Partner Programs, Azure Marketplace
vikram.patel@azure.microsoft.com

Attachment: azure-marketplace-checklist.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@opticloud.com>, Vikram Patel <vikram.patel@azure.microsoft.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner solution workshop: Redwood + OptiCloud - scheduling / architecture deep-dive

Quick update — Laura (my manager) will be OOO for part of Mon morning and wants to review the attendee list and objectives before we lock. To keep momentum, can we tentatively confirm Mon, Mar 1 15:00-16:00 PST (60 min) as a fallback? That aligns with Samir's preference for afternoon and should be OK for Vikram if needed.

I'm attaching our architecture diagram (v2) and a short telemetry checklist for the meeting prep. Neha — please confirm if 60 minutes is sufficient to cover the walkthrough and a short marketplace Q&A; otherwise we should keep 75 minutes.

If everyone confirms, I'll send a calendar invite with Zoom and attach these documents. HubSpot link for the account is included below for reference.

Thanks,
Marissa
Biz Dev Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: architecture-diagram-v2.png; azure-marketplace-checklist.pdf
Links: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/contacts/4801, https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2b3C4d5E6F7/view

Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner solution workshop: Redwood + OptiCloud - scheduling / architecture deep-dive

Marissa —

Confirmed from our side: Mon Mar 1 15:00-16:00 PST works. Attendees: Samir Shah, Priya Reddy (Product), Arjun Rao (Lead Engineer). We'll forward a calendar invite shortly.

Arjun will review the architecture diagram and telemetry notes in advance. If you want to include any sandbox credentials or a short runbook for onboarding, please attach them to the calendar invite.

Looking forward to it —
Samir
Head of Partnerships, OptiCloud Solutions
